description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520801
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, and ownership details) in the Kohuwala area. The content focuses on land ownership determinations, property registrations, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
